doc_kind: medical policy (benefit-plan specific; criteria delegated to InterQual)
criteria_location: Coverage Rationale (p.1) contains only a pointer list to InterQual subsets plus a short list of unproven procedures. Real medical-necessity criteria are in InterQual (not in the PDF). Definitions (pp.1-2) are the only in-document quantified content: instability >= 3 mm, anticipated instability, unstable Grade I spondylolisthesis, Meyerding grades, radiographic dynamic instability, staged multiple sessions.
procedures_covered: Cervical, thoracic and lumbar fusion and decompression (InterQual)
Dynamic stabilization, facet joint replacement, isolated facet fusion, MOTUS-type implants (unproven)

logic.top_level: other (pointer to external criteria set plus a NOT list of unproven procedures)
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Bulleted list of procedures 'unproven and not medically necessary due to insufficient evidence of efficacy'.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Staged multiple sessions rule only: 'Dividing treatment ... into serial or Staged Multiple Sessions when one session can address all sites is unproven and not medically necessary'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Radiographic Dynamic Instability: Translational motion of 3 mm of movement on flexion-extension radiographs or Meyerding Classification System of Spondylolisthesis grade of >= II.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: '3 mm' stated without 'at least'; compare Instability definition '>= 3 mm'. Defined terms are never used in any criterion visible in this document.

requirement_kinds.quote: For medical necessity clinical coverage criteria, refer to the: InterQual CP: Procedures: Fusion, Lumbar Spine ... InterQual Client Defined, CP: Procedures, Decompression +/- Fusion, Lumbar (Custom) - UHG
Instability: ... difference in translational alignment between lumbar vertebrae greater than or equal to 3 mm between views
Anticipated Instability Due to Procedure: ... excision of greater than 50% of bilateral facet joints; removal of greater than 75% of one facet joint or 50% or more of the vertebral body
Unstable Grade I Degenerative Spondylolisthesis: ... Sagittal translation >= 3 mm; Angular change of >= 15 degrees between flexion and extension
Staged Multiple Sessions: Includes procedures that are performed on different days or those that require an additional anesthesia session.

thresholds.quote: greater than or equal to 3 mm between views
Angular change of >= 15 degrees between flexion and extension
Meyerding Classification System of Spondylolisthesis grade of >= II
excision of greater than 50% of bilateral facet joints
removal of greater than 75% of one facet joint

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: One long CPT table (pp.2-8) with no mapping to InterQual subsets or to the unproven list, apart from 0202T, 0219T-0222T, 0719T (facet/dynamic devices) that match the unproven list by description.
codes.non_covered_code_lists: Not explicit; the 'unproven' procedures can be matched to 0202T, 0219T-0222T, 0719T only by reading descriptions.
